}}'''Yuan''' (pronounced: you-AHN) is an [[Arafel]]lin [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yuan}}

==Appearance==
Yuan is gray-eyed and slim.

==History==
She is from Arafel.{{ref/book|0|10}}

Yuan was present at [[Moiraine Damodred]]'s test for the [[shawl]].{{ref/book|0|9}} Yuan was displeased with what [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] did during the last stage of Moiraine's test, as Elaida seemed to try to make Moiraine fail.{{ref/book|0|10}}
